briefings.title: President Trump and the First Lady Participate in a Military Mother's Day Event
briefings.tldr: President Donald J. Trump and First Lady Melania Trump hosted a White House event to honor the "quiet power" and sacrifices of military mothers while providing updates on a $1.5 trillion military investment and record-breaking recruitment numbers.

briefings.title: Washington (5-6-26): Iran says it is reviewing latest U.S. peace plan; Ted Turner dies
briefings.tldr: Iran is currently reviewing a U.S. peace proposal to end the ongoing conflict, amid a "wall of steel" naval blockade and President Trump’s ultimatum of escalated bombing; meanwhile, the U.S. national debt has officially surpassed 100% of GDP for the first time since World War II.
